name: Senco Gold
why: Management outlook: We have maintained the same guidance with the Q1 results this year.
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual profit
Margins shrinking (10% to 7%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 5 to 10, inventory days 220 to 286 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Weak (sales +67% YoY, profit -4% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 2.5 pts in a year
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 90% to 93% of sales)
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only -113% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: We have maintained the same guidance with the Q1 results this year.
If you look at our overall performance over the past 2 -3 years, we have always been somewhat conservative in giving guidance.
risks: We also need to keep in mind that this quarter presented both opportunities and challenges, especially with almost 65% to 70% of our business coming from Eastern India and West Bengal.
We also need to understand that the quarter faced certain headwinds, including Adhik Maas and the heat wave.
focus: In terms of new stores added during the quarter, we added 3 company-owned, company-operated stores, 4 franchise stores and 1 Sennes showroom focused on lab-grown diamonds.
In line with our strategy, the majority of the stores we open will be franchise stores, with a focus on East and North India.
However, Q2 is the quarter in which we focus on planning and building inventory so that we are well prepared for the festive season.
